question: ‘Faster than Lightning: My Autobiography’ is the story of which of the following international sprinters?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Usain Bolt **__**.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Autobiography of the fastest runner ever and a superstar whose talent and charisma have made him one of the most famous people on the planet.
 
• Bolt holds the 100m, 200m and 4×100m records at both the Olympic and World Championships.
 
• **He is the world record holder in the 100 m, 200 m, and 4 × 100 m relay.**
 
• An eight-time Olympic gold medalist, Bolt is the only sprinter to have **won the Olympic 100m and 200m titles in three consecutive Olympics (2008, 2012 and 2016).**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/995584fbb65bf0922fb3071cfafe163605baf3ee6d0991fa67eb6ec13472790b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Justin Gatlin** is one of the most controversial athletes in athletics.
 
• United States Justin Gatlin won the men's 100 meters final at the Olympic Stadium during the 2004 Olympic Games in Athens.
 
• **Christian Coleman** is an American professional track and field sprinter who competes in the 100 meters and 200 meters.
 
• **Michael Arthur Norman Jr. is an American sprinter. He is the world record holder in indoor 400 meters in 44.52 seconds**.
